Position purpose
To safely and efficiently carry out on-site glazing works, including the installation, replacement and adjustment of glass in windows, doors and related building products. The role is responsible for delivering work to Integra Windows' quality standards, project requirements and applicable safety procedures.
Key duties and responsibilities
•	Install glass into window and door frames on residential and commercial construction sites.
•	Remove and replace damaged, incorrect or defective glass when required.
•	Read and interpret plans, glazing schedules, measurements, job sheets and installation instructions.
•	Confirm glass type, size, orientation and location before installation, and promptly report discrepancies.
•	Handle, load, unload, transport and store glass using appropriate equipment and safe handling methods.
•	Prepare frames and openings, install glazing components, gaskets, packers, sealants and related materials, and complete finishing work to the required standard.
•	Inspect completed glazing for correct fit, operation, finish, damage and cleanliness before leaving site.
•	Protect finished products and surrounding surfaces and minimise damage to the customer's property and other trades' work.
•	Take clear site photographs and complete job, service and defect records as required.
•	Communicate professionally with the Operations Manager, builders, site supervisors, customers and other trades.
•	Maintain company tools, glazing equipment and vehicles in a clean, safe and serviceable condition.
•	Assist with related installation, service, factory or loading duties when reasonably required.
•	Carry out other reasonable duties within the employee's skills and competence as directed by the Operations Manager.
Work health and safety
•	Follow company WHS policies, site rules, Safe Work Method Statements (SWMS), risk controls and lawful directions at all times.
•	Use required personal protective equipment and appropriate glass-handling, lifting and access equipment.
•	Identify and report hazards, incidents, injuries, damaged equipment and unsafe work conditions immediately.
•	Do not perform work that is unsafe or outside the employee's training, authorisation or competence.
•	Maintain a valid White Card and comply with site induction requirements.
Skills, experience and requirements

Essential
•	Practical experience in glazing and the installation of glass in windows and doors.
•	Ability to read plans, glazing schedules and measurements accurately.
•	Good physical fitness and capacity to safely undertake manual handling associated with glass installation.
•	Current Australian driver's licence and ability to travel between construction sites.
•	Current White Card (General Construction Induction).
•	Sound understanding of safe glass handling, site safety and the correct use of glazing tools and equipment.
•	Strong attention to detail, reliability, punctuality and a professional approach on customer sites.
•	Ability to work independently and cooperatively as part of an installation team.

Desirable
•	Relevant glazing trade qualification or recognised industry training.
•	Experience with double-glazed units and uPVC, aluminium or timber window and door systems.
•	Experience using mechanical lifting aids and specialist glass-handling equipment.
Performance expectations
•	Complete allocated glazing work safely, accurately and within reasonable job timeframes.
•	Achieve a high standard of workmanship with minimal defects, damage, rework or call-backs.
•	Attend sites on time, keep the Operations Manager informed of progress and raise issues promptly.
•	Maintain professional conduct and leave work areas safe, clean and presentable.

Physical and work environment requirements
This is a physically demanding, site-based role. The employee must be able to safely handle glass and glazing materials; stand, bend, kneel, reach and work in varied site conditions; use access and lifting equipment where trained and authorised; and travel to different construction sites. Team lifting and mechanical aids must be used whenever required by the task or risk assessment.

We have outstanding opportunity for a highly experienced and skilled ELECTRICAL ENGINEER . We are looking for trustworthy individuals with integrity who will bring a positive can-do attitude to the position and to the team. Position available in Vic, Qld, WA, and NSW

JOB OVERVIEW
Electrical Engineer is responsible for designing, developing, and testing electrical systems and components, ensuring they meet required safety standards, performance specifications, and regulatory guidelines.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES AND DUTIES include but are not limited to:
Contribute to the design of primary and secondary electrical systems, including switchgear, transformers, and protection systems
Support the development of schematics and one-line diagrams for substation layouts, ensuring optimal electrical distribution and safety
Work with senior engineers to create comprehensive electrical design documents that meet both operational and regulatory requirements
Provide technical expertise by way of reviewing and refining substation layout drawings, ensuring they are aligned with system performance expectations and safety codes
Use software and perform detailed calculations to plan, design and develop manufacturing, construction and installation standards and specifications to improve electrical systems
Participate in relay setting configurations to ensure coordinated protection for fault isolation and equipment safeguarding

Participate in risk assessments to identify potential hazards and propose mitigation strategies

Maintain thorough documentation of design decisions, equipment specifications, and protection schemes for accurate project execution
Document all design revisions, including any changes in equipment specifications, settings, and system configurations
Perform detailed reviews and quality checks on electrical designs, ensuring they meet project and compliance requirements
Maintain compliance with operational standards to ensure the substation meets grid stability and power quality requirements
Assist with any ad hoc duties as required

SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE/QUALIFICATIONS

Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering
A minimum of 2 years of experience in electrical engineering

SOFT SKILLS
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Excellent communication skills both written and verbal

Ability to work confidently both as part of a team and autonomously
